stopping: Fixed 32 pairs per worker domain, no outcome-based interim stop, sample extension, retuning or discarded completed game. Integrity/cancellation failures preserve evidence and suspend affected run; no automatic replay under the same name. Watchdog 90 minutes per domain.
analysis: All games independently replayed for legality/terminal/history and complete-request telemetry. Report WDL, pentanomial, pair-score mean and pair-level normal95 (when valid) plus conservative Hoeffding95. Development-selected estimates are exploratory. Two worker domains are correlated multiple looks; no confirmatory claim from either or their combination. Report elapsed, all Search requests/nodes/time, process CPU including JIT/GC/abort/drain, peak working set and frozen inputs.
selectionRule: Fresh fixed-sample confirmation may follow only in a domain with candidate score at least0.55 and no integrity/resource concern; this is an economical development-selection rule (~35 descriptive logistic Elo), not an acceptance threshold or claim of significance. Below0.50 closes this formulation in that domain as unpromising at this resource; 0.50..0.55 stays inconclusive/deferred unless a separately justified new hypothesis offers concrete decision value. Do not tune full-window or mine individual openings. Confirmation uses new partition1 roots, fixed identity and prospectively frozen analysis before games.
resourcePlan: Pilot forecast determines whether one-/four-worker confirmation fits preferred workstation windows. Prefer up to128 fresh confirmation pairs per selected domain; freeze exact sample/alpha/decision before confirmation. Cap combined substantial confirmation to a background-friendly window, ordinarily under6h; report uncertainty rather than manufacture more games. No automatic production promotion.
